description: This file defines interfaces related to serialization codecs in the Orleans framework, including a generic interface for field codecs, a marker interface for derived type codecs, and callback hooks for serialization stages.

classes.name: UntypedCodecWrapper<TField>
classes.description: A wrapper class that allows an IFieldCodec to be used as a generic IFieldCodec for a specific type TField.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Method to write a field with a specific buffer writer, field ID delta, expected type, and value.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Method to read a value of type T from a reader, given a field.
